rules.rule: Retain native source IDs and source snapshots. Identical IDs with different payloads require version/conflict review; never silently overwrite.
Repeated brand/product names and matching compared ingredient/serving cores are review groups, not canonical products.
Retain direct labelRelationships with their source type and pointer. Do not infer transitive product equivalence.
Retain distinct NatMed claim IDs, field support, dose/population context and pending clinical review even when excerpts or spans repeat.
Retain distinct Reddit record and passage IDs, thread/parent/time/URL context. Repeated text does not establish one author or experience.
Exact UTF-8 text may share a text blob with per-source bindings. Text reuse is not entity merging or independent corroboration.
Reuse terminology namespace/native IDs only. High concept mapping confidence does not imply equivalence of products or ingredient occurrences.

merge_policy: No new canonical entity merges in this batch; product equivalence remains unresolved where not established.
